scope.market_definition: The smart meter market encompasses devices that measure energy consumption and communicate data to utilities for monitoring and billing purposes. Key participants include manufacturers, distributors, and service providers operating globally to enhance energy efficiency and grid management.

## Together, we build efficient, optimised, and sustainable solutions

For 80 years, Kamstrup has striven to make every measurement matter. Through collaboration and
innovation, we develop smart metering solutions that protect water, secure energy, and optimise
performance while reducing costs.

By empowering utilities and building performance managers to act with confidence, not guesswork, we
take operational efficiency and resource management beyond today's standards.

**We Make What You Measure Matter**

A technology platform partner for utilities worldwide, that provides scalable, interoperable,
future-proof communications, and enables grid decisions while turning data into operational
intelligence.

Trilliant enables utilities to gain real-time visibility and optimize performance across an
increasingly dynamic, distributed energy environment, from AMI to grid-edge intelligence. Across RF,
cellular, and hybrid, with a platform built for DERs, EVs, and what's next. Backed by decades of AMI
expertise and strong technology partnerships, we deliver future‑ready solutions for the evolving
energy landscape.

### Connectivity and Grid Edge

Connect every grid asset reliably and at scale.
Build a resilient, future-ready network foundation for the modern grid.

[Read More][42]

### Data and Control

Turn network data into real-time visibility and control.

[Read More][43]

### Applications and Intelligence

Transform data into actionable grid intelligence,
Drive better outcomes across reliability, efficiency, and customer engagement as a smart utility.

[Read More][44]

Traditional AMI was designed for meter reading and billing.
Today's grid must support: Distributed Energy Resources (DERs), Rapid EV adoption, Increasing
reliability and resilience demands, and Real-time operational decision-making - All while moving
from beyond infrastructure to include intelligence.

Trilliant is dedicated to providing our valued customers with the power to choose only the solutions
you need that will ensure the most successful outcomes and endpoints.
Our [Power of Choice][45] device-independent platform means you have flexibility and
interoperability.

## Together, we build efficient, optimised, and sustainable solutions

For 80 years, Kamstrup has striven to make every measurement matter. Through collaboration and
innovation, we develop smart metering solutions that protect water, secure energy, and optimise
performance while reducing costs.

By empowering utilities and building performance managers to act with confidence, not guesswork, we
take operational efficiency and resource management beyond today's standards.

**We Make What You Measure Matter**

[About Kamstrup][58]
Watch video

## Stories from our customers 

Explore our case stories and discover how, together with our customers, we have pushed the
boundaries of modern metering through innovation and dedication. 
[Customer references][59]
[
[2024-11-20_Front page_case pictures_NEW2]

#### Reversing water loss in a rural municipality

With a 51% water loss equivalent to 750 million litres annually, Oneida was in serious trouble.
However, despite topographical challenges and limited resources, Kamstrup quickly helped the
municipality bounce back and become a source of inspiration for other utilities. 
][60]
[
[2024-11-20_Front page_case pictures_NEW4]

#### Solrød Forsyning lowers return temperature with RTO

Using Kamstrup's Return Temperature Optimizer (RTO), Solrød Forsyning gets help identifying errors
in both old and new heating installations thus optimising the district heating network and
increasing customer satisfaction. 
][61]
[
[2024-11-20_Front page_case pictures_NEW8]

#### Prepaid electricity helps Lephalale municipality to evolve

Using smart prepaid meters, a South African municipality was able to curb meter tampering, prevent
electricity theft, and recover significant revenue losses.The community now enjoys better resource
management, flexible payment options, and improved power supply reliability.
][62]
[
[2024-11-20_Front page_case pictures_NEW6]

#### Reliable cooling for cutting-edge research

Aarhus University’s ASTRID2 particle accelerator depends on precise, high-frequency data from
Kamstrup cooling meters to maintain optimal 24/7 operation. This seamless integration ensures
continuous uptime and enhanced energy efficiency, supporting groundbreaking research in a
sustainable way.
][63]
[
[2024-11-20_Front page_case pictures_NEW]

#### How digital meters save Vacarisses water, money, and time

Challenged by severe water loss, Vacarisses municipality replaced its mechanical water meters with
ultrasonic Kamstrup meters. The upgrade didn’t just reduce the water loss – it also helped the local
water utility by optimizing operations while reducing expenses. 
][64]

## Together, we build efficient, optimised, and sustainable solutions

For 80 years, Kamstrup has striven to make every measurement matter. Through collaboration and
innovation, we develop smart metering solutions that protect water, secure energy, and optimise
performance while reducing costs.

By empowering utilities and building performance managers to act with confidence, not guesswork, we
take operational efficiency and resource management beyond today's standards.

**We Make What You Measure Matter**

# [Discover the Power of Choice]
# 

A technology platform partner for utilities worldwide, that provides scalable, interoperable,
future-proof communications, and enables grid decisions while turning data into operational
intelligence.

[Explore Your AMI Roadmap][41]

### A Modern Platform for a Modern Grid

Trilliant enables utilities to gain real-time visibility and optimize performance across an
increasingly dynamic, distributed energy environment, from AMI to grid-edge intelligence. Across RF,
cellular, and hybrid, with a platform built for DERs, EVs, and what's next. Backed by decades of AMI
expertise and strong technology partnerships, we deliver future‑ready solutions for the evolving
energy landscape.

### Connectivity and Grid Edge

Connect every grid asset reliably and at scale.
Build a resilient, future-ready network foundation for the modern grid.

[Read More][42]

### Data and Control

Turn network data into real-time visibility and control.
Move from data collection to real-time grid awareness.

[Read More][43]

### Applications and Intelligence

Transform data into actionable grid intelligence,
Drive better outcomes across reliability, efficiency, and customer engagement as a smart utility.

[Read More][44]

### The Grid Has Changed. Now AMI Must Respond.

Traditional AMI was designed for meter reading and billing.
Today's grid must support: Distributed Energy Resources (DERs), Rapid EV adoption, Increasing
reliability and resilience demands, and Real-time operational decision-making - All while moving
from beyond infrastructure to include intelligence.

Trilliant is dedicated to providing our valued customers with the power to choose only the solutions
you need that will ensure the most successful outcomes and endpoints.
Our [Power of Choice][45] device-independent platform means you have flexibility and
interoperability.

Watch our new video to learn how Trilliant is Powering Grid Intelligence with the Power of Choice.

# [Discover the Power of Choice]
# 

A technology platform partner for utilities worldwide, that provides scalable, interoperable,
future-proof communications, and enables grid decisions while turning data into operational
intelligence.

[Explore Your AMI Roadmap][41]

### A Modern Platform for a Modern Grid

Trilliant enables utilities to gain real-time visibility and optimize performance across an
increasingly dynamic, distributed energy environment, from AMI to grid-edge intelligence. Across RF,
cellular, and hybrid, with a platform built for DERs, EVs, and what's next. Backed by decades of AMI
expertise and strong technology partnerships, we deliver future‑ready solutions for the evolving
energy landscape.

### Connectivity and Grid Edge

Connect every grid asset reliably and at scale.
Build a resilient, future-ready network foundation for the modern grid.

[Read More][42]

### Data and Control

Turn network data into real-time visibility and control.
Move from data collection to real-time grid awareness.

[Read More][43]

### Applications and Intelligence

Transform data into actionable grid intelligence,
Drive better outcomes across reliability, efficiency, and customer engagement as a smart utility.

[Read More][44]

### The Grid Has Changed. Now AMI Must Respond.

Traditional AMI was designed for meter reading and billing.
Today's grid must support: Distributed Energy Resources (DERs), Rapid EV adoption, Increasing
reliability and resilience demands, and Real-time operational decision-making - All while moving
from beyond infrastructure to include intelligence.

Trilliant is dedicated to providing our valued customers with the power to choose only the solutions
you need that will ensure the most successful outcomes and endpoints.
Our [Power of Choice][45] device-independent platform means you have flexibility and
interoperability.

Watch our new video to learn how Trilliant is Powering Grid Intelligence with the Power of Choice.

## A Complete, Plug-and-Play Smart Metering Ecosystem

As pioneers in smart metering, we proudly offer one of the few truly all-encompassing solutions. Our
plug-and-play ecosystem integrates Smart Meters, Communication Networks, Head End Systems, and Meter

## Who We Are?

## We pioneer unique solutions for the smart grid ecosystem

Our journey started with a mission: to create SMART and efficient utility solutions.Today, we stand
out by offering comprehensive solutions, combining high-end metering, advanced communication,
cutting-edge software, and consulting.

## Digi2Smart

Adya’s Digi2Smart is a solution that transforms traditional digital electricity meters into advanced
smart meters. This patented, plug-and-play technology significantly reduces capital expenditure by
eliminating the need for meter replacements, cutting costs by half. By simply plugging the
Digi2Smart module into an existing digital meter, utilities can avoid power disruptions and lengthy
deployment cycles, enabling faster transitions across millions of meters.

The environmental benefits are equally impactful, as Digi2Smart prevents e-waste by repurposing
existing meters, reducing the ecological footprint of meter replacements. Tailored for India’s scale
and price-sensitive market, Digi2Smart is designed to ensure rapid adoption without compromising
affordability. Adya’s innovative solution is a leap forward in sustainable and efficient energy
management.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

## EV Charging Questions, Answered

How do EV charging stations work?

Electric charging stations function by converting power from the electrical grid to direct current
that electric vehicles use. DC fast chargers, which allow quick charging in minutes using higher
voltages and wattages, are only available at public stations. 

Drivers plug their vehicles into the electric vehicle charging stations, which deliver power to the
vehicle's battery charging system. When done, drivers unplug so the next EV can charge up from the
ever-flowing grid power supply. Home stations wire directly into the home's electrical system.

[Answers to your questions when installing ev chargers.][18]

Are EV charging stations worth it?

Yes, due to all the long-term benefits. See below for the three primary reasons EV charging stations
are worthwhile.
1. **Preparing for the future:** As more people embrace electric vehicles, electric charging
   infrastructure will be necessary, and businesses that install stations will position themselves
   for future success. [EVs are here to stay][19].
2. **Reduced energy costs:** EVs are cheaper than gas vehicles, saving fleet operators money on
   fuel.
3. **Customer retention/attraction:** Having an electric charging station works to attract and
   retain customers, as EV drivers frequently visit places with convenient charging stations. 

Can owning an EV charging station be profitable?

Owning an EV charging station can be a profitable business opportunity as it has recurring revenue
streams. Offering an EV charging solution provides profit from charging fees. 

As the EV market continues expanding to [meet consumer demand and sustainability goals][20], more EV
drivers will need access to a commercial charging station, increasing the volume of fees an EV
charging station collects. Locating stations in busy areas like coffee shops, restaurants,
convenience stores, and malls is a great strategy to enhance an EV charging experience, [contribute

## EV Charging Questions, Answered

How do EV charging stations work?

Electric charging stations function by converting power from the electrical grid to direct current
that electric vehicles use. DC fast chargers, which allow quick charging in minutes using higher
voltages and wattages, are only available at public stations. 

Drivers plug their vehicles into the electric vehicle charging stations, which deliver power to the
vehicle's battery charging system. When done, drivers unplug so the next EV can charge up from the
ever-flowing grid power supply. Home stations wire directly into the home's electrical system.

[Answers to your questions when installing ev chargers.][18]

Are EV charging stations worth it?

Yes, due to all the long-term benefits. See below for the three primary reasons EV charging stations
are worthwhile.
1. **Preparing for the future:** As more people embrace electric vehicles, electric charging
   infrastructure will be necessary, and businesses that install stations will position themselves
   for future success. [EVs are here to stay][19].
2. **Reduced energy costs:** EVs are cheaper than gas vehicles, saving fleet operators money on
   fuel.
3. **Customer retention/attraction:** Having an electric charging station works to attract and
   retain customers, as EV drivers frequently visit places with convenient charging stations. 

Can owning an EV charging station be profitable?

Owning an EV charging station can be a profitable business opportunity as it has recurring revenue
streams. Offering an EV charging solution provides profit from charging fees. 

As the EV market continues expanding to [meet consumer demand and sustainability goals][20], more EV
drivers will need access to a commercial charging station, increasing the volume of fees an EV
charging station collects. Locating stations in busy areas like coffee shops, restaurants,
convenience stores, and malls is a great strategy to enhance an EV charging experience, [contribute
to sustainable transportation,][21] and make more profits.

Why should I consider installing an EV charging station?

One important reason to install an electric vehicle charging station is to demonstrate your
commitment to sustainability by supporting clean energy options. Then, as EV adoption increases,
you’ll be [ahead of the curve][22] by offering electric vehicle charging availability for customers.
You can generate income from fees, subscriptions, advertising, or premium parking by providing
charging. Any place with EV charging stations makes more profits as charging drives more foot
traffic and spending at shopping centers and parks.

What factors should I consider when choosing an EV charging station?

When choosing electric car charging stations, consider the following factors:
* Intended location
* Desired charging speeds
* Number of ports you’ll need
* Maximum power output 
* Payment options 
* Safety certifications
* Equipment warranties, service, and support

[Considerations for installing EV charging stations at your location.][23]

What types of EV charging stations do you offer?

At Blink, we offer electric vehicle charging station products for commercial and residential use. We
offer Level 2 charging stations and DC fast chargers for commercial properties. [Why should you
consider a Level 2 charging station?][24]

Our products provide Level 2 and DC fast charging capabilities in various form factors like
pedestals, wall mounts, and mobile units.

Is any maintenance required for EV charging stations?

Yes, maintenance is required for electric cars’ charging stations to ensure proper and safe
operation and reduce downtime. [Ways of maintaining EV charge stations][25] include cleaning
connectors or ports to remove debris. It’s also best to inspect ports for loose connections and
faults and perform software updates to optimize performance. 

What support services do you offer?

Blink provides 24/7 customer support through multiple channels to address any questions. We also
install new equipment, perform maintenance and repair, and perform remote monitoring to maintain
functionality. 

Additional services include over-the-air software updates and training resources for customers and
partners. Blink aims to offer a reliable EV charging experience with around-the-clock assistance.

Blink offers [turnkey EV charging services][26], including installation, maintenance, and support,
to keep your charging stations running smoothly for longer.

## Company Overview

Yueqing Xingyang Electronic Co., Ltd. (CNXY for short) is an enterprise specialized in the design,
production and sale of electric equipment. Our company has an office located in the largest
manufacturing base of electric equipment - Wenzhou, which is called "the Electric Equipment Capital
of China". CNXY has five specialized branches and over 300 specialized cooperative partners. CNXY,
an ISO9001 certified enterprise, has modern production lines and high quality control equipment,
with scientific administration, professional engineers, well trained teams and technicians and
skilled workers. Now CNXY has five design and production bases in Hong Kong, Taiwan area, Singapore,
Turkey and Wenzhou (China Mainland) respectively, 28 sales organizations around the world and more
than 50 holding member enterprises. CNXY products include low-voltage apparatuses, welding
equipment, instruments and meters, photoelectron products, electrical products for construction,
automobile apparatus and industrial automatic equipment. Our products are sold to more than 100
countries and regions. All the export products have passed CE certification and some products have
passed several international certifications like RoHS, TUV, UL, KEMA, SIRIM and so on. Your Success,
Our Glory Our aim is to help customers realize their goals. We are making great efforts to achieve
this win-win situation and sincerely welcome you to join us.

### Industrial Energy Management System Software and Smart Energy Meter Solution

[ See More ][132]

#### Residential Blocks

Real-time data monitoring of the power supply of national grid and microgrid, monitoring power
consumption data and establishing prepaid accounts for users in the block (such as merchants,
residents, etc.),  the [**prepayment system**][133] provides users with a convenient payment channel
to ensure that users pay fees in a timely and accurate manner.

#### Commercial Building

Monitor the environment data and energy consumption of different applications in real time, such as
HVAC, lighting, and lifting, and discover energy-saving points.
Combined with intelligent control equipment and [**microgrid management system**][134], it can
realize intelligent environmental control, air conditioning energy-saving intelligent control,
lighting energy-saving intelligent control, etc., to help achieve green building goals.

#### Manufacturing

Establish an industrial [**energy management system**][135] to monitor energy consumption from
different dimensions and throughout the life cycle, conduct layer-by-layer monitoring and refined
management from the enterprise level to departments, workshops, production lines, equipment, etc.,
improve energy quality, optimize energy assets, ensure reliable operation of energy-consuming
equipment, monitor and improve energy efficiency, find energy-saving space, and establish scientific
energy consumption assessment indicators.

#### Mining

Mine energy monitoring includes energy consumption monitoring of high-energy-consuming equipment,
transportation systems, ventilation and drainage systems, energy efficiency and full life cycle
management of major equipment, predictive maintenance, energy efficiency benchmarking management,
carbon emissions and ESG compliance, etc. Energy saving and consumption reduction can be achieved by
combining on-site waste heat recovery and renewable energy and microgrid integration.

## Innovation

With a constantly-expanding open hub with dedicated resources, Conlog drives, develops & incubates
ideas from all corners of our business, empowering us to stay ahead of industry trends & disrupt the
markets through innovation.

people, planet & prosperity.

We are committed to growth & improvement, expanding our product range, pursuing global expansion,
and developing deeper customer understanding.

# World leaders in smart metering solutions

200+ patents & trademarks | Presence in 58+ countries | A global footprint of 17+ million smart
meters | Servicing 90+ utilities & 50+ million households

Backed by decades of experience, innovation and expertise, Conlog is a world leader in smart
metering solutions. With a global network of more than 17 million meters spanning over 58 countries,
we have established ourselves as the gold standard of smart metering technology.

Our smart meters assist our customers with utility management, revenue enhancement, load management
and demand management, focusing on big data analytics and smart grid solutions.

As a proudly South African black industrialist company with local shareholders, we hold our B-BBEE
Level 1 certification. Our electrical meters and water meters are manufactured using 98% and 85%
local materials respectively, contributing to the economic upliftment of our country.

mA. I purchased the second meter and installed it using one of the 24 volt inputs and have now been
using it for over a month (~1000 gallons per day) with no problems.

## Powering Transformation

like no other

World is advancing rapidly and the power sector is one of the most vital pillars that is making it
possible. India is no exception. The Indian Government has undertaken various programmes and
initiatives to improve operational efficiency and financial sustainability of utilities by providing
result-linked financial assistance. With the help of these schemes, utilities will have increased
access to funds for deploying Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) and Smart Meters. ...This will
help in modernization of the grid as well as loss reduction. The progressive measures by the policy
makers have no doubt accelerated power sector development in India. It is no different globally.
Governments across the globe have earmarked funding for grid modernisation and are engaged in
developing and enacting policies that support smart technologies including AMI and smart metering.
As pioneers in Electronic Energy Meters in India and with over 80+ million meters installed, Genus
has been at the forefront of metering since its inception in 1995. Currently Genus is among the
largest players in electricity metering solutions industry in India, with 27% (appx) market share
and is poised to scale new heights both locally and globally.
Armed with increased installed capacity of meters, Genus is looking at the future with lots of
promise and potential to make a powerful impact on the utility providers around the world.

[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to

## 15-year experience in providing smart water meters using its embedded ultrasonic technology

Since 2010 INTEGRA Metering Ultrasonic stands for metering technology based on its own technology,
high quality standards, and a wide range of water meters, from district to domestic, for potable
water, C&I and irrigation segments

## Committed to deliver quality products

We build on our over 15-years experience to deliver customized water meters to utilities,
municipalities, operators, distributors and partners. Our products feature full certification for
measurement instrument directives (e.g. MID) and international potable water regulations (e.g. ACS,
WRAS, SVGW, DVGW, KTW, BELGAQUA).

## Environmental protection

Protecting the environment is part of our identity. We take particular attention to comply with
environmental law and guidelines, and use a large range of indicators to assess our environmental
performance. By providing smart water meters we help water conservation and sustainable water use,
enabling accurate measurement of water usage, and encouraging consumers to use water more
responsibly

the measurement standards required by fiscal regulations.We undertake periodic verification and
calibration, ensuring that your meters operate accurately and reliably.

About Us
Indo Overseas Marketing has grown as a consistent trader and supplier within the industrial
community. We are expert providers of quality products like Control Panels, DOL Starter Panels,
Monoblock Pumps, Submersible Pumps, Electricity Meters, and so forth. Our quest for excellence and
customer satisfaction has led us to become the preferred option for customers from all walks of
industry.

**Market Reputation**

We have established a good market reputation through the years for our dependability, integrity, and
customer focus. Our delivery and commitment to excellence have gained the confidence of many clients
from various industries. We are gratified with our record of fulfilling and surpassing customer
expectations, which has earned us long-term relationships with our respected clients.

**Vendor Base**

Our large vendor base is a reflection of our robust industry relationships and dedication to
purchasing the finest products. We partner with major manufacturers and suppliers to provide a wide
variety of quality products. This strategic network enables us to provide competitive prices, prompt
delivery, and creative solutions to address the special needs of each of our customers.

To facilitate our operations, we maintain well-fitted warehouse facilities at Faridabad, Haryana.

storing a broad spectrum of products, enabling speedy order processing and timely deliveries. This
organized storage system enables us to keep our inventory levels in optimum condition, thereby
minimizing lead times and allowing our customers to receive their orders promptly.

Indo Overseas Marketing keeps expanding and developing, guided by our dedication to excellence and
customer satisfaction. We eagerly anticipate serving you with the same devotion that has been our
hallmark since 1995.

# INESH SMART ENERGY

**INESH** an innovative technology solution provider in energy sector. Our Smart product range in
metering, communication and software can be the right fit for a complete Smart Grid ECO Systerm.  A
Renowned R&D Design house and manufacturer of smart meter, smart grid prodcuts and Telecom Energy
management products. Our Innovative patented first of its kind Smarte™ is a golden platter solution
for the meter manufacturers who wish to be and (AMI) smart meter manufacturer.

**INESH’s** powerful **Smarte****™** smart metering system on module enables the meter manufacturers
and utilities to manufacture and deploy truly interoperable highly secure smart meter and smart grid
at an ease and in shortest possible time. Inesh’s IPV6 technology platform connects homes,
businesses and communities smarter, better and faster.

Inesh Smart Energy (P) LTD is an Indian incorporation of a Global venture, incorported in Chennai to
transfer the technology advantage to Indian Smart grid oppurtunity and Energy management in Utility
and Telecom sectors.

Inesh offers a high quality energy solution and and products in the utility, telecom and renewable
energy markets. INESH’s modular approach and open standard flexibile and plug play communciation
architecutre enables the fastest smart grid rollout for the utilites and smart meter providers.

## Wasserversorgung

Im Wasserbereich bietet INTEGRA Metering ein komplettes Portfolio an intelligenten Messlösungen
sowie qualitativ hochwertige und zuverlässige Brauchwasserzähler für die Bereiche Trinkwasser,
Haushalte, Netzwerk und Bewässerung an. Alle Wasserzähler verfügen über eine vollständige
Zertifizierung nach Messgeräterichtlinien (z.B. MID) und lokalen und internationalen
Trinkwasserverordnungen (z.B. SVGW, KTW, WRAS, ACS).

Durchflusszählern und Temperaturfühlern für Heiz- und Kühlanwendungen in Industrie-, Gewerbe- und
Wohngebäuden sowie in der Nah- und Fernwärmeversorgung an. INTEGRA Metering kombiniert sein
Premium-Produktangebot mit den erforderlichen Kommunikationstechnologien und

What is advanced metering infrastructure and how does it work?
[Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI)][56] is an integrated system that brings together [smart
meters][57], communication networks, and data management software to enable seamless, two-way
communication between utilities and consumers.

Kimbal’s AMI solution is designed to make energy management simpler and more efficient for
utilities. It combines Kushal smart meters, [ImGATI in-meter gateway][58], Vayu RF-Mesh
communication infrastructure, Vaani Head-End System (HES), and cellular communication via [Network
Interface Cards (NIC)][59]. Together, these components help utilities track energy consumption in
real time, remotely connect and disconnect supply, and automate billing, without requiring physical
meter reading.
What variants of smart meters does Kimbal manufacture?
Kimbal offers a comprehensive range of smart meters designed to meet the needs of residential,
commercial, and utility applications. This includes single-phase, three-phase, LTCT, HT, feeder, and
distribution transformer (DT) meters.

All [Kimbal smart meters][60] are IS 16444-compliant, ensuring dependable performance across diverse
geographical conditions and use cases. Built with advanced capabilities such as real-time
monitoring, accurate billing, remote communication, and tamper detection, these meters help
utilities operate more efficiently while giving consumers better visibility into their energy usage.
With a product defect rate below 0.5%, the smart meters are designed for reliability and long-term
performance, making them a trusted choice for smart metering deployments across India.
What is a Head-End-System and what does Kimbal Vaani HES offer?
A Head-End System (HES) is the central platform that communicates with smart meters to collects
meter data and sends commands across the smart metering network.

[Vaani is Kimbal’s enterprise-grade Head-End System][61] designed to make smart metering operations
easier and more efficient. Vaani’s open architecture ensures seamless interoperability with smart
meters from multiple OEMs, giving utilities greater flexibility and control.

Vaani also provides real-time insights, intelligent automation, reliable command execution, and zero
data loss, helping utilities manage their networks with confidence. Its architecture scales
seamlessly to support growing deployments. With an open and flexible design, Vaani also integrates
easily with Meter Data Management (MDM) systems, making it a future-ready solution for utilities of
any size.
What communication technology does Kimbal use for AMI connectivity?
Kimbal’s primary connectivity solution is its KMesh. KMesh is a Made-in-India mesh network designed
to deliver reliable communication even in challenging environments. It enables fast network
convergence, robust multi-hop data routing, and multi-layered encryption, ensuring secure and
consistent data transfer across the smart metering network.

Kimbal also offers a Cellular 4G communication module for areas that require wider coverage. With
dual-SIM support, seamless network switching, and 2G fallback, it helps maintain uninterrupted
connectivity, even in locations where network availability may be intermittent or inconsistent.
What is a Network Interface Card (NIC) and why does it matter?
A [Network Interface Card (NIC)][62] is the communication module in a smart meter that enables it to
connect to the wider AMI network. In simple terms, it acts as the bridge between the meter and the
utility’s system, enabling seamless data transfer.

Kimbal’s NIC supports both RF-Mesh (NAN) and Cellular 4G

### Future-proof your street lighting with open standards

[ [DALI Logo] ][93]
[ [TALQ Logo] ][94]
[ [ZHAGA Logo] ][95]

At Kurrant, we advocate for interoperability in street lighting systems. TALQ's openAPI enables
seamless communication between diverse solutions, ZHAGA ensures hardware interoperability across LED
modules and sensors, while DALI provides standardized lighting control protocols.

Interoperability isn't just a technical advantage—it's a strategic necessity that reduces costs,
increases innovation, and ensures your smart lighting infrastructure can evolve with the best
available technologies, regardless of manufacturer.

As a top energy management company in China, we are dedicated to providing 100% reliable and
high-quality smart meters, solar energy storage batteries, energy management software and effective
AMI solutions. It’s time to embrace the future of a more sustainable energy distribution. Through
these services and devices, we are changing the way businesses and consumers measure and optimize
energy, helping achieve a greener and more sustainable energy system that works better for
sustainability and efficiency.

Founded in 1996, **Londian** is a global leader in smart meter technology and energy innovation.
With cutting-edge R&D, advanced production, and reliable after-sales support, we’ve delivered **30
million+ smart meters** worldwide, empowering energy efficiency and sustainability.

**Our Mission:**
* Pioneer **smart metering solutions** for a low-carbon future.
* Drive **renewable energy infrastructure** and climate-target alignment.
* Commit to **green technology**, cost savings, and global partnerships.

# Online Automated Metering Infrastructure

## Metering Excellence Through Technology

## Login Options

Take control of your meter.

### Residential Tenants/Owners

#### RegisterNew Users
* Instant access for Protea Metering clients with Smart Meters
* Tenants or Owners
* Valid E-mail address and Cellphone number required
* Register Multiple Users
* Registration is easy and free

[Click here to REGISTER][12]

### Residential Tenants/Owners

#### LoginRegistered Users
* View balance/available credit
* View daily, weekly and monthly usage
* View monthly water and electricity graphs
* View predicted usage
* Set up notifications to warn if you are running low
* Purchase prepaid electricity/Top-up your account

[Click here to LOGIN][13]

### Managing agents/Landlords

#### LL LoginFor prevetted Property Managers
* Financial breakdowns (Income & Expenses, Levy Rolls
* Shared Services (Consumption & Recovery)
* Water and Electricity Schematics & Audits
* Resident management (Low/High credit & usage)
* Credit Control, Monthly reports and more...

[Click here to LOGIN][14]

## About your OAMI Account

Registration for your OAMI account is free. Once you have registered you will have full access to
your OAMI account. This means that you will be able to view and monitor your usage, view your
statement, make payments (via debit order, credit card or EFT) online, purchase electricity via SMS,
receive low credit SMS notifications, and much much more. Once you have topped up your account the
credit token will be automatically delivered to your meter (if you have a smart prepaid meter).
* E-wallet accounts: Daily consumptions will be deducted from your available credit on your
  e-wallet. If you have credit, you will have electricity
* Prepaid accounts: Once you have topped up your account the credit token will be automatically
  delivered to your meter (if you have a smart prepaid meter).
* 10+ methods available to top-up your account.

This service is only available for Protea Metering clients. If you are unsure if you should register
on OAMI, please feel free to contact our friendly call centre agents. All our contact details can be
viewed at [www.ProteaMetering.co.za][15].
If you are a property developer, body corporate or managing agent and would like to make use of the
OAMI system, please contact our marketing department via [www.ProteaMetering.co.za][16].

**IMPORTANT:** You must have an OAMI installed smart meter to make use of the functionality. You
must register an account to be able to top up your account. Administration costs may be charged by
your provider on transactions. Our sites are designed with the latest technology such as HTML 5 and
javascript. If you have an older browser such as Internet Explorer 6, 7 or 8 you may have limited
functionality on your account. We advise that you download and install a modern browser such as
Mozilla Firefox or Google Chrome.

[Learn More][17]

### Discover everything about OAMI and the **services** offered

Meter reading made easy, complete control over accounts & billing, take control over water and

## OAMI Products

The engineers behind the OAMI technology have designed state-of-the-art products that are a world
first. These products are physical devices that works along with the latest AI technology which
impowers homeowners to take complete control over the electricity consumption in their homes for
little to no cost. These products could help homeowners to account for each and every kWh
electricity they consume. Depending on the utility provider, the consumer could not only save money
but could also be compensated by the utility for generating electricity using a privately owned
electricity generating device such as a grid-tied solar system.

These physical products and unqiue software can also help municipal and reseller utilities to
implement complicated tariff structures like Time-Of-Use, grid-tied solar systems and owner
self-generation. Not to mention the cost savings benefits to the utility company by using the
specialised communication network provided by these OAMI products.

There are a myriad of advantages by using these products, but the greatest advantage is that it is a
win-win for all parties. It helps utility providers to minimize loss and illegal consumption, and it
ensures that the end-user or homeowner is billed fairly.

These modules make communication to meters effortless and efficient, especially at large complexes,
where meter readers have difficulty gaining access or where meter readers are not available.

Voltage sensors are wired or wireless components that can be attached to any number of meters,
switches or equipment. They constantly monitor, calculate and determine the voltage supply, and
provide enough information to ensure the user identify problems as soon as they occur.

## 旺玖科技

### 全球知名的 IC 設計領導廠商

旺玖科技為一家全球知名的 IC 設計領導廠商，專注於 USB
智慧型輸出入控制晶片、機電整合技術及智慧綠色能源解決方案。旺玖科技提供的晶片系統整合解決方案，包含
USB 介面橋接晶片、USB
儲存產品、無刷馬達控制器、霍爾原件感測器、智能電表及微機電感測器相關產品。旺玖科技成立於 1997 年 11
月，公司總部設於台灣，並於中國大陸、美國、日本、韓國等地區設有銷售服務據點。

About Prolific

## 旺玖科技

### 全球知名的 IC 設計領導廠商

旺玖科技為一家全球知名的 IC 設計領導廠商，專注於 USB
智慧型輸出入控制晶片、機電整合技術及智慧綠色能源解決方案。旺玖科技提供的晶片系統整合解決方案，包含
USB 介面橋接晶片、USB
儲存產品、無刷馬達控制器、霍爾原件感測器、智能電表及微機電感測器相關產品。旺玖科技成立於 1997 年 11
月，公司總部設於台灣，並於中國大陸、美國、日本、韓國等地區設有銷售服務據點。

# Innovative, nachhaltige
# und wirtschaftliche Systemlösungen
# für die Energiebranche

## Damit Sie zukunftssicher mit EFR steuern, messen und kommunizieren.

[Serviceprovider Netzsteuerung][57]
[Unsere Systemlösungen][58]
[Mehr über uns erfahren][59]

### Seit 30 Jahren vertrauen mehr als 350 Unternehmen und Kommunen unseren Systemlösungen.

## Unsere Systemlösungen für die Energiebranche

Die EFR-Systemlösungen umfassen alles Erforderliche für das Management und die
End-to-End-Kommunikation: Software, mehrere Kommunikationskanäle zur Auswahl und die passenden
Hardwarekomponenten.
Ziel ist die zuverlässige Umsetzung von Netzführungsaufgaben.

Da alle Komponenten des Systems aufeinander abgestimmt sind, lassen sich die EFR-System-Lösungen
auch bei umfassender Funktionalität einfach einführen und bedienen.

### Bereit für den Smart-Grid-Rollout?

Wir haben ein Vollservice-Angebot für das Einspeisemanagement nach § 9 EEG und das Steuern nach §
14a EnWG für Sie entwickelt.

[Unser Pilotsystem][60]

### Tarif- und Laststeuerung

Für die Tarif- und Laststeuerung bieten wir Lösungen mit dem EFR-Langwellen-Broadcastsystem, unsere
Hybridlösung oder die modulare Softwareplattform GMS.

[Unsere Tarif- und Laststeuerung][61]

### Redispatch 2.0 / Einspeisemanagement

Die faire Lösung, um Einspeiser erneuerbarer Energie ans Netz zu nehmen und Überlastungen zu
vermeiden. Intuitiv zu bedienen, sicher in der Anwendung. 

[Unser Redispatch 2.0 / Einspeisemanagement][62]

### Beleuchtungssteuerung

Unser auf Langwelle basierende Lösung zum Steuern der öffentlichen Beleuchtung – preiswert, schnell
und zuverlässig. 

[Unsere Beleuchtungssteuerung][63]

### M2M Mobilfunk

Die einfache Lösung zur Anbindung IP-basierter Endgeräte. Zum kleinen Tarif, aber mit einer
großartigen Netzverfügbarkeit. 

[Unser M2M Mobilfunk][64]

### Prädiktive Gebäudesteuerung

Ein Langwellen-Datenservice und Empfangsgeräte, die beim Heizen und Kühlen Klimaschutz- und
Sparpotenziale eröffnen.

[Unser Prädiktive Gebäudesteuerung][65]

## Über die EFR GmbH

Die EFR GmbH ist ein Systemanbieter im Bereich Energiemanagement in Deutschland und Mitteleuropa.

Unter dem Motto „Zukunftssicher Steuern, Messen, Kommunizieren“ bietet EFR Komplettlösungen für das
digitale Netzmanagement des Smart Grid.

[Unser Unternehmen][66]

und ein Informationssicherheits-Management-System (ISMS) und ist zertifiziert nach:

#### ISO 9001:2015

# Smart Meters

## What is SmartMe?

SmartMe is an independent UK website explaining how electricity and gas smart meters work.

The site provides clear technical explanations of the UK smart meter system, including how smart
meters communicate, the differences between SMETS1 and SMETS2 meters, and how consumers can monitor
and understand their energy usage.

SmartMe was created by engineers with experience in smart meter technology and energy systems. The
goal of the site is to provide accurate, easy-to-understand information about smart meters, how they
operate, and how they affect households across the United Kingdom.

Topics covered on SmartMe include:
* How smart meters work
* SMETS1 vs SMETS2 meters
* Smart meter communications networks
* Home Area Networks and In-Home Displays
* The UK smart meter rollout
* Common smart meter questions and problems.

## The truth about Smart Meters - the good and the bad

[Simple diagram showing how meters and IHD connect.]

Energy supply companies have been installing smart meters for electricity and gas in homes across
Great Britain since 2012. By 2025, all residential and small businesses across England, Scotland and
Wales will be offered a smart meter by their energy supplier.

In Northern Ireland the Department for the Economy (DfE) has recommended an electricity smart meter
roll-out over six years starting in 2027. A gas roll-out won't be included as the benefits were not
sufficient.

A smart meter sends an electronic meter reading to your energy supplier, meaning:
* they won't need to take a manual meter reading - as the meters send back readings themselves
* you won't get estimated bills - as actual readings are available
* it'll be easier to switch energy suppliers - as the reading at changeover is readily available
* there should be less arguments - as the readings are reliable and not subject to disagreement.

You'll also get a digital display in your home, helping you to keep track of how much energy you're
using and how much it's costing.

You won't have to pay for your smart meter or digital display up front - the cost will be included
in everyone's energy bill over the next few years.

A smart meter won't change how you currently pay for your energy bill, e.g. monthly, or prepaid.
This will still be determined by the product and payment method you choose.

Smart Meters and their roll-out haven't been perfect and they've been the subject of negative
headlines. What do these headlines really mean?
* **Smart Meters don't work** - this headline has covered different problems over time, so let's
  break it down into the different reasons:
  * **Incorrect Bills** - When the Smart Meters fail to send in readings suppliers use estimates.
    This can go on for a while and can sometimes result in an unexpectedly large bill when a reading
    finally gets through.
    The meters are still recording accurately so customers just need to check their bill is not
    using estimates and send in a [manual reading][36] if necessary. If you do not want to check
    your bill just send in a meter reading every month as you would with a traditional meter.
  * **IHD not working** - Many customers call the In Home Device that usually sits on the worktop in
    their kitchen their “meter”. So, when that doesn't work they complain their meter is not
    working. Their meter is working and recording energy accurately but, frustratingly, they cannot
    see that on the IHD. They have to go to their meter to [read][37] their consumption.
    Solutions to the IHD being too far away from the Comms Hub are being investigated by the [Alt

goal of the site is to provide accurate, easy-to-understand information about smart meters, how they
operate, and how they affect households across the United Kingdom.

Topics covered on SmartMe include:

* Smart meter communications networks
* Home Area Networks and In-Home Displays

* Common smart meter questions and problems.

## The truth about Smart Meters - the good and the bad

[Simple diagram showing how meters and IHD connect.]

Energy supply companies have been installing smart meters for electricity and gas in homes across
Great Britain since 2012. By 2025, all residential and small businesses across England, Scotland and
Wales will be offered a smart meter by their energy supplier.

In Northern Ireland the Department for the Economy (DfE) has recommended an electricity smart meter
roll-out over six years starting in 2027. A gas roll-out won't be included as the benefits were not
sufficient.

A smart meter sends an electronic meter reading to your energy supplier, meaning:
* they won't need to take a manual meter reading - as the meters send back readings themselves
* you won't get estimated bills - as actual readings are available
* it'll be easier to switch energy suppliers - as the reading at changeover is readily available
* there should be less arguments - as the readings are reliable and not subject to disagreement.

You'll also get a digital display in your home, helping you to keep track of how much energy you're
using and how much it's costing.

You won't have to pay for your smart meter or digital display up front - the cost will be included
in everyone's energy bill over the next few years.

A smart meter won't change how you currently pay for your energy bill, e.g. monthly, or prepaid.
This will still be determined by the product and payment method you choose.

Smart Meters and their roll-out haven't been perfect and they've been the subject of negative
headlines. What do these headlines really mean?
* **Smart Meters don't work** - this headline has covered different problems over time, so let's
  break it down into the different reasons:
  * **Incorrect Bills** - When the Smart Meters fail to send in readings suppliers use estimates.
    This can go on for a while and can sometimes result in an unexpectedly large bill when a reading
    finally gets through.
    The meters are still recording accurately so customers just need to check their bill is not
    using estimates and send in a [manual reading][36] if necessary. If you do not want to check
    your bill just send in a meter reading every month as you would with a traditional meter.
  * **IHD not working** - Many customers call the In Home Device that usually sits on the worktop in
    their kitchen their “meter”. So, when that doesn't work they complain their meter is not
    working. Their meter is working and recording energy accurately but, frustratingly, they cannot
    see that on the IHD. They have to go to their meter to [read][37] their consumption.
    Solutions to the IHD being too far away from the Comms Hub are being investigated by the [Alt
    HAN Co Ltd][38].
  * **No communications** - Communication with the meters is essential to set up tariffs and
    prepayment mode. Without communications your meter will operate as a traditional one rate meter,
    and you'll have to take your own readings. Understandably customers get very frustrated when
    their meters can't communicate and yet they have a good mobile signal and a good broadband
    connection. Progress to find alternative solutions for the [Wide Area Network (WAN)][39] have
    been slow which is again frustrating as the barriers to a solution are not technical but
    political.
  * **Stops working after changing supplier** - Older [SMETS 1][40] meters operated on many
    different management systems and could not always be supported when a customer changed supplier
    as the systems tended to be supplier specific. [SMETS 2][41] meters do not have this problem as
    a common system is used operated by the Data Communications Company (DCC).
* **North South Divide** - As the characteristics of the North and South of the country are
  different, a different communications system was setup for the two areas. Each system has pros and
  cons but sensibly a longer-range radio system was used in the North. However, customers in the
  North can get frustrated when they have a perfectly good mobile phone signal and the Long Range
  Radio signal to their meter is too weak for communication to work successfully. This has now been
  addressed as mobile 4G communications can be used in Scotland and the North of England from
  30^{th} May 2025.
  So, one could now argue that the North has better communications options than the South. See more
  information on our [SMETS 2][42] page.

Many people have questions about Smart Meters, this website tries to answer them honestly for
electricity and gas meters, thoroughly and without bias. This site does not deal with Smart water
meters as our team do not have expertise in that area.

## Supreme Court][15]

Posted on [November 19, 2025][16] by [Josh Hart][17]

Hello Safer Technology Supporter,

It is imperative that YOU submit comments ASAP (if you haven’t already) opposing BOTH the latest
move by the corrupt FCC to **obliterate** local planning control over cell towers AND laws moving
through congress that echo these efforts:

1) See crucial and timely federal red alert from Vicki Sievers below. Follow instructions. See links
at the bottom for sample letters and other resources.

2) Click [here][18] to send a note of opposition on similar bills going through congress.

Also, thanks to your support, we will be reprinting Public Health Warning Cards and Smart Meter
Awareness brochures and they should be available in early 2026. We also have posters, displays,
pre-owned emf meters of various types, and other materials not shown in our [online store][19].
 [Contact us][20] for more details. We still have hundreds of wireless warning cards (en espanol)
that are FREE if you can help us distribute them to spanish speaking communities.

**Send in your FCC comments today, let congress hear how pissed off you are about this and make sure
to send copies to all your elected officials!  ******

**“Hill to Die on” sounds serious! Better pay attention!**

Begin forwarded message:

 

**From: **Vicki Sievers <[vickisievers911@gmail.com][21]>

**Subject: ****!! IMPT ACTIONS to save local control of cell towers/antennas**

**Date: **November 16, 2025 at 00:01:06 PST

**To: **Vicki Sievers <[victoriasievers@earthlink.net][22]>

 

**STOP ****COMPLETE**** FCC TAKEOVER OF WIRELESS DEPLOYMENT!**

 

Big thanks for action you’ve already taken. 

** **

If you have not yet acted, please do so right away. Submissions are imperative. So much is at stake,
and the clock is ticking.****

 

**WHAT IS HAPPENING: ****FCC rulemaking** (No. 25-276: “Build America: Eliminating Barriers to
Wireless Deployments”) seeks to render local governments powerless by removing regulations now in
effect. **The proposal allows  Big Telecom to install ****antennas anywhere they please**.
**It**** wipes out ordinance protections (local zoning, setbacks) that citizens and cities achieved
in Marin-Sonoma and elsewhere in 2018-19. It strips away any legal means of fighting back, and
silences public input. Increased surveillance will usher in unprecedented loss of privacy.**

 

**ACTION STEPS**

**#1) Compose a brief (or any length) letter in a Word document (or by hand). Save it so you can
file it with the FCC and send separate copies to elected officials. (You may want to convert it to a
pdf.)**

**Type or write in email subject line:**** Re: ****WC Docket No. 25-276, Build America: Eliminating
Barriers to Wireless Deployment.**

In the body of the letter you might tell if you or persons you know have been injured or affected in
any way by wireless deployments. Be factual, and include relevant resources if you can. Include any
of the excellent CHD talking points offered below.* Also see three sample letters linked below;
these are in Word format so that you may borrow, modify, personalize.

In **cc** line** list any of the following parties that you choose—title + name: ** Your Mayor; your
City Council members; your State Senator; your State Assembly rep; your US Congressperson; CA US
Senators Adam Schiff and Alex Padilla. (If you are handwriting, list cc parties below your
signature)

**#2:**  **Submit or mail your letter to the FCC****  **Use FCC online docket or US Postal Service.

(Docket Proceeding now open: Submission deadline to be announced soon.) **Choose ONE below:**

**    • Submit express filings **to FCC docket:

Go to [https://www.fcc.gov/ecfs/filings/express][23]. Under proceeding(s), enter **25-276** so that
it populates.

Fill in your name, address, email, etc. (follow the prompts).

Note: Express filings do not separate paragraphs or preserve formatting. 

**          • Submit standard filings** to FCC docket:

Standard submission preferred when sending a letter.

Go to [https://www.fcc.gov/ecfs/filings/standard][24]. Under proceeding(s), enter **25-276** so that
it populates.

Follow prompts. When asked what type of filing, choose: “Comment” …red means *required.

Submit your letter as a Word doc or pdf attachment and include any other attachments that support
your letter.

**• Submit via US Post Office:**

Address letter to:

**     **       Office of the Secretary Marlene Dortch

Federal Communications Commission

45 L Street NE, Washington, DC 20554

## 3-Phase Energy Meters for Industry

Tech OVN is a dedicated energy meter manufacturer building a 3-phase electronic energy meter range
for industrial sub-metering: DIN rail smart energy meters, WiFi energy meters, and cloud-connected
industrial energy meters — all designed and produced in-house. Our Titan meter is an industrial
energy meter with Class 0.5S accuracy per IEC 62053-22, built for factory and commercial
sub-metering where utility-grade data actually matters.

Whether you're specifying a 3 phase smart energy meter for a new factory, retrofitting a wifi energy
meter to an existing switchboard, or sourcing an IoT energy meter for a multi-site portfolio — the
[Titan 3 phase energy meter][9] covers all three with a single DIN rail SKU.

white goods, this market offers a wealth of opportunities to create products that enhance everyday
life.

generation of consumer electronics, ensuring a smarter, more connected future.

environmental monitoring, resource management, renewable energy generation, and pollution control.

offer a range of products, solutions, expertise, and technology centres to empower you throughout
your projects.

### Medical

monitoring through real time data analytics.

cutting-edge software, and consulting.

## Digi2Smart

Adya’s Digi2Smart is a solution that transforms traditional digital electricity meters into advanced
smart meters. This patented, plug-and-play technology significantly reduces capital expenditure by
eliminating the need for meter replacements, cutting costs by half. By simply plugging the
Digi2Smart module into an existing digital meter, utilities can avoid power disruptions and lengthy
deployment cycles, enabling faster transitions across millions of meters.

The environmental benefits are equally impactful, as Digi2Smart prevents e-waste by repurposing
existing meters, reducing the ecological footprint of meter replacements. Tailored for India’s scale
and price-sensitive market, Digi2Smart is designed to ensure rapid adoption without compromising
affordability. Adya’s innovative solution is a leap forward in sustainable and efficient energy
management.

## EV Charging Questions, Answered

How do EV charging stations work?

Electric charging stations function by converting power from the electrical grid to direct current
that electric vehicles use. DC fast chargers, which allow quick charging in minutes using higher
voltages and wattages, are only available at public stations. 

Drivers plug their vehicles into the electric vehicle charging stations, which deliver power to the
vehicle's battery charging system. When done, drivers unplug so the next EV can charge up from the
ever-flowing grid power supply. Home stations wire directly into the home's electrical system.

[Answers to your questions when installing ev chargers.][18]

Are EV charging stations worth it?

Yes, due to all the long-term benefits. See below for the three primary reasons EV charging stations
are worthwhile.
1. **Preparing for the future:** As more people embrace electric vehicles, electric charging
   infrastructure will be necessary, and businesses that install stations will position themselves
   for future success. [EVs are here to stay][19].
2. **Reduced energy costs:** EVs are cheaper than gas vehicles, saving fleet operators money on
   fuel.
3. **Customer retention/attraction:** Having an electric charging station works to attract and
   retain customers, as EV drivers frequently visit places with convenient charging stations. 

Can owning an EV charging station be profitable?

Owning an EV charging station can be a profitable business opportunity as it has recurring revenue
streams. Offering an EV charging solution provides profit from charging fees. 

As the EV market continues expanding to [meet consumer demand and sustainability goals][20], more EV
drivers will need access to a commercial charging station, increasing the volume of fees an EV
charging station collects. Locating stations in busy areas like coffee shops, restaurants,
convenience stores, and malls is a great strategy to enhance an EV charging experience, [contribute
to sustainable transportation,][21] and make more profits.

Why should I consider installing an EV charging station?

One important reason to install an electric vehicle charging station is to demonstrate your
commitment to sustainability by supporting clean energy options. Then, as EV adoption increases,
you’ll be [ahead of the curve][22] by offering electric vehicle charging availability for customers.
You can generate income from fees, subscriptions, advertising, or premium parking by providing
charging. Any place with EV charging stations makes more profits as charging drives more foot
traffic and spending at shopping centers and parks.

What factors should I consider when choosing an EV charging station?

What factors should I consider when choosing an EV charging station?

When choosing electric car charging stations, consider the following factors:
* Intended location
* Desired charging speeds
* Number of ports you’ll need
* Maximum power output 
* Payment options 
* Safety certifications
* Equipment warranties, service, and support

## Company Overview

Yueqing Xingyang Electronic Co., Ltd. (CNXY for short) is an enterprise specialized in the design,
production and sale of electric equipment. Our company has an office located in the largest
manufacturing base of electric equipment - Wenzhou, which is called "the Electric Equipment Capital
of China". CNXY has five specialized branches and over 300 specialized cooperative partners. CNXY,
an ISO9001 certified enterprise, has modern production lines and high quality control equipment,
with scientific administration, professional engineers, well trained teams and technicians and
skilled workers. Now CNXY has five design and production bases in Hong Kong, Taiwan area, Singapore,
Turkey and Wenzhou (China Mainland) respectively, 28 sales organizations around the world and more
than 50 holding member enterprises. CNXY products include low-voltage apparatuses, welding
equipment, instruments and meters, photoelectron products, electrical products for construction,
automobile apparatus and industrial automatic equipment. Our products are sold to more than 100
countries and regions. All the export products have passed CE certification and some products have
passed several international certifications like RoHS, TUV, UL, KEMA, SIRIM and so on. Your Success,
Our Glory Our aim is to help customers realize their goals. We are making great efforts to achieve
this win-win situation and sincerely welcome you to join us.

### Producto 100% argentino

][40]

Los productos de DISCAR son íntegramente desarrollados y producidos en la Argentina, cumpliendo con
normas y estándares internacionales, con procesos certificados bajo norma ISO 9001-2015. Esto
significa garantía de continuidad, soporte y evolución permanente sin disrupciones.

[

### Soporte 24/7

][41]

El soporte preventa y posventa es un elemento distintivo de nuestra Empresa y a la vez es la
garantía del éxito de todas las instalaciones en las que DISCAR es el partner tecnológico de smart
metering. Asesoramos a nuestros clientes para elegir la mejor opción para cada caso, y los apoyamos
durante el despliegue y en la integración con sus sistemas.

[

### Stock Permanente

][42]

Conocemos las necesidades de nuestros clientes, y muchas veces es necesario brindar respuesta
inmediata a una necesidad que implique proveer de manera inmediata. Para ello, en DISCAR contamos
con stock permanente de todos los modelos de medidores. No dependemos de las limitaciones y los
caprichos de la importación de productos terminados.

[

### Aseguramos la inversión

][43]

Asegurar la inversión es clave: cuando un producto es sorpresivamente discontinuado el cliente puede
perder la totalidad de su inversión aún antes de haber cumplido su ciclo de recupero de la
inversión. Los productos de DISCAR aseguran continuidad, soporte y retro-compatibilidad a nivel de
software, para asegurar a nuestros clientes el recupero de su inversión.

initiatives to improve operational efficiency and financial sustainability of utilities by providing
result-linked financial assistance. With the help of these schemes, utilities will have increased
access to funds for deploying Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) and Smart Meters. ...This will
help in modernization of the grid as well as loss reduction. The progressive measures by the policy

developing and enacting policies that support smart technologies including AMI and smart metering.

has been at the forefront of metering since its inception in 1995. Currently Genus is among the
largest players in electricity metering solutions industry in India, with 27% (appx) market share
and is poised to scale new heights both locally and globally.
Armed with increased installed capacity of meters, Genus is looking at the future with lots of
promise and potential to make a powerful impact on the utility providers around the world.

[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to
assess IPC Digital Twin readiness level and how to prepare an organization of any size or production
volume to implement a full IPC Digital Twin approach to

## 15-year experience in providing smart water meters using its embedded ultrasonic technology

high quality standards, and a wide range of water meters, from district to domestic, for potable

municipalities, operators, distributors and partners. Our products feature full certification for
measurement instrument directives (e.g. MID) and international potable water regulations (e.g. ACS,

# Homepage

Integra Metering Systems is a company specializing in the supply of electric, water, gas and heat
meters,offers advanced reading services for electricity. Since 2008, it has collaborated with Itron,
offering innovative solutions for energy consumption monitoring and efficient resource management.
Integra is also active in the renewable energy sector, providing state-of-the-art devices for
sustainable and smart energy use.

About Us
Indo Overseas Marketing has grown as a consistent trader and supplier within the industrial
community. We are expert providers of quality products like Control Panels, DOL Starter Panels,
Monoblock Pumps, Submersible Pumps, Electricity Meters, and so forth. Our quest for excellence and
customer satisfaction has led us to become the preferred option for customers from all walks of
industry.

**Market Reputation**

We have established a good market reputation through the years for our dependability, integrity, and
customer focus. Our delivery and commitment to excellence have gained the confidence of many clients
from various industries. We are gratified with our record of fulfilling and surpassing customer
expectations, which has earned us long-term relationships with our respected clients.

**Vendor Base**

Our large vendor base is a reflection of our robust industry relationships and dedication to
purchasing the finest products. We partner with major manufacturers and suppliers to provide a wide
variety of quality products. This strategic network enables us to provide competitive prices, prompt
delivery, and creative solutions to address the special needs of each of our customers.

To facilitate our operations, we maintain well-fitted warehouse facilities at Faridabad, Haryana.
Our warehouses are equipped with a sophisticated organized storage system for safely and efficiently
storing a broad spectrum of products, enabling speedy order processing and timely deliveries. This
organized storage system enables us to keep our inventory levels in optimum condition, thereby
minimizing lead times and allowing our customers to receive their orders promptly.

Indo Overseas Marketing keeps expanding and developing, guided by our dedication to excellence and
customer satisfaction. We eagerly anticipate serving you with the same devotion that has been our
hallmark since 1995.

# INESH SMART ENERGY

**INESH** an innovative technology solution provider in energy sector. Our Smart product range in
metering, communication and software can be the right fit for a complete Smart Grid ECO Systerm.  A
Renowned R&D Design house and manufacturer of smart meter, smart grid prodcuts and Telecom Energy
management products. Our Innovative patented first of its kind Smarte™ is a golden platter solution
for the meter manufacturers who wish to be and (AMI) smart meter manufacturer.

**INESH’s** powerful **Smarte****™** smart metering system on module enables the meter manufacturers
and utilities to manufacture and deploy truly interoperable highly secure smart meter and smart grid
at an ease and in shortest possible time. Inesh’s IPV6 technology platform connects homes,
businesses and communities smarter, better and faster.

Inesh Smart Energy (P) LTD is an Indian incorporation of a Global venture, incorported in Chennai to
transfer the technology advantage to Indian Smart grid oppurtunity and Energy management in Utility
and Telecom sectors.

Inesh offers a high quality energy solution and and products in the utility, telecom and renewable
energy markets. INESH’s modular approach and open standard flexibile and plug play communciation
architecutre enables the fastest smart grid rollout for the utilites and smart meter providers.

## Wasserversorgung

Im Wasserbereich bietet INTEGRA Metering ein komplettes Portfolio an intelligenten Messlösungen
sowie qualitativ hochwertige und zuverlässige Brauchwasserzähler für die Bereiche Trinkwasser,
Haushalte, Netzwerk und Bewässerung an. Alle Wasserzähler verfügen über eine vollständige
Zertifizierung nach Messgeräterichtlinien (z.B. MID) und lokalen und internationalen
Trinkwasserverordnungen (z.B. SVGW, KTW, WRAS, ACS).

## Thermische Energie

Im Bereich der thermischen Energie bietet INTEGRA Metering eine grosse Auswahl an Rechenwerken,
Durchflusszählern und Temperaturfühlern für Heiz- und Kühlanwendungen in Industrie-, Gewerbe- und
Wohngebäuden sowie in der Nah- und Fernwärmeversorgung an. INTEGRA Metering kombiniert sein
Premium-Produktangebot mit den erforderlichen Kommunikationstechnologien und
Top-Engineering-Dienstleistungen, um die besten Messlösungen und Systemintegration zu gewährleisten.

## Questions

What is advanced metering infrastructure and how does it work?
[Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI)][56] is an integrated system that brings together [smart
meters][57], communication networks, and data management software to enable seamless, two-way
communication between utilities and consumers.

Kimbal’s AMI solution is designed to make energy management simpler and more efficient for
utilities. It combines Kushal smart meters, [ImGATI in-meter gateway][58], Vayu RF-Mesh
communication infrastructure, Vaani Head-End System (HES), and cellular communication via [Network
Interface Cards (NIC)][59]. Together, these components help utilities track energy consumption in
real time, remotely connect and disconnect supply, and automate billing, without requiring physical

## Questions

What is advanced metering infrastructure and how does it work?
[Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI)][56] is an integrated system that brings together [smart
meters][57], communication networks, and data management software to enable seamless, two-way
communication between utilities and consumers.

Kimbal’s AMI solution is designed to make energy management simpler and more efficient for
utilities. It combines Kushal smart meters, [ImGATI in-meter gateway][58], Vayu RF-Mesh
communication infrastructure, Vaani Head-End System (HES), and cellular communication via [Network
Interface Cards (NIC)][59]. Together, these components help utilities track energy consumption in
real time, remotely connect and disconnect supply, and automate billing, without requiring physical
meter reading.
What variants of smart meters does Kimbal manufacture?
Kimbal offers a comprehensive range of smart meters designed to meet the needs of residential,
commercial, and utility applications. This includes single-phase, three-phase, LTCT, HT, feeder, and
distribution transformer (DT) meters.

All [Kimbal smart meters][60] are IS 16444-compliant, ensuring dependable performance across diverse
geographical conditions and use cases. Built with advanced capabilities such as real-time
monitoring, accurate billing, remote communication, and tamper detection, these meters help
utilities operate more efficiently while giving consumers better visibility into their energy usage.
With a product defect rate below 0.5%, the smart meters are designed for reliability and long-term
performance, making them a trusted choice for smart metering deployments across India.
What is a Head-End-System and what does Kimbal Vaani HES offer?
A Head-End System (HES) is the central platform that communicates with smart meters to collects
meter data and sends commands across the smart metering network.

[Vaani is Kimbal’s enterprise-grade Head-End System][61] designed to make smart metering operations
easier and more efficient. Vaani’s open architecture ensures seamless interoperability with smart
meters from multiple OEMs, giving utilities greater flexibility and control.

Vaani also provides real-time insights, intelligent automation, reliable command execution, and zero
data loss, helping utilities manage their networks with confidence. Its architecture scales
seamlessly to support growing deployments. With an open and flexible design, Vaani also integrates
easily with Meter Data Management (MDM) systems, making it a future-ready solution for utilities of
any size.
What communication technology does Kimbal use for AMI connectivity?
Kimbal’s primary connectivity solution is its KMesh. KMesh is a Made-in-India mesh network designed
to deliver reliable communication even in challenging environments. It enables fast network
convergence, robust multi-hop data routing, and multi-layered encryption, ensuring secure and
consistent data transfer across the smart metering network.

Kimbal also offers a Cellular 4G communication module for areas that require wider coverage. With
dual-SIM support, seamless network switching, and 2G fallback, it helps maintain uninterrupted
connectivity, even in locations where network availability may be intermittent or inconsistent.
What is a Network Interface Card (NIC) and why does it matter?
A [Network Interface Card (NIC)][62] is the communication module in a smart meter that enables it to
connect to the wider AMI network. In simple terms, it acts as the bridge between the meter and the
utility’s system, enabling seamless data transfer.

Kimbal’s NIC supports both RF-Mesh (NAN) and Cellular 4G

Registration for your OAMI account is free. Once you have registered you will have full access to
your OAMI account. This means that you will be able to view and monitor your usage, view your
statement, make payments (via debit order, credit card or EFT) online, purchase electricity via SMS,
receive low credit SMS notifications, and much much more. Once you have topped up your account the
credit token will be automatically delivered to your meter (if you have a smart prepaid meter).
* E-wallet accounts: Daily consumptions will be deducted from your available credit on your
  e-wallet. If you have credit, you will have electricity
* Prepaid accounts: Once you have topped up your account the credit token will be automatically
  delivered to your meter (if you have a smart prepaid meter).
* 10+ methods available to top-up your account.

This service is only available for Protea Metering clients. If you are unsure if you should register
on OAMI, please feel free to contact our friendly call centre agents. All our contact details can be
viewed at [www.ProteaMetering.co.za][15].
If you are a property developer, body corporate or managing agent and would like to make use of the
OAMI system, please contact our marketing department via [www.ProteaMetering.co.za][16].

**IMPORTANT:** You must have an OAMI installed smart meter to make use of the functionality. You
must register an account to be able to top up your account. Administration costs may be charged by
your provider on transactions. Our sites are designed with the latest technology such as HTML 5 and
javascript. If you have an older browser such as Internet Explorer 6, 7 or 8 you may have limited
functionality on your account. We advise that you download and install a modern browser such as
Mozilla Firefox or Google Chrome.
